# Liz / lizliz.xyz

> Hangzhou. Liz writes, and ships things that are interesting and useful. Personal site for essays, small products, and downloadable skill / template packs.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://lizliz.xyz/): writing + shipped projects
- [Articles](https://lizliz.xyz/articles): essays and notes
- [Skills](https://lizliz.xyz/skills): free downloadable agent skill packs (landing replication, Doubao TTS, video scripts, GEO job hunt, WebGL backgrounds, DESIGN.md)
- [Templates](https://lizliz.xyz/templates): free downloadable design template pack (DESIGN.md visual systems, landing templates, UI micro-patterns, craft checklists)
- [AdventureX 2026 volunteer channel data portrait](https://lizliz.xyz/adventurex-2026/): 106 volunteers, 4,779 messages, 23 days
- [RSS](https://lizliz.xyz/rss.xml): article feed
- [Sitemap](https://lizliz.xyz/sitemap.xml)

## Notes for crawlers

- Canonical host is the apex `https://lizliz.xyz` (not www / pages.dev).
- Client language switch is EN default + ZH overlay; do not invent `/zh/` URL variants as separate documents.
